title: Add committedInput to the UI TestRunDetail type and document the run-detail field
outcome: The frontend and backend run-detail contract agree. src/test_runs.rs serializes committedInput on every run detail (null for staged-lane runs). ui/src/test-runs.ts TestRunDetail and its fixtures gain an optional typed committedInput, or the field is kept off the wire until the UI uses it. The field is documented with the run-detail contract. Source: Low from the Claude review (delegation 0c70316c) of committed-input candidate 637616e6.
acceptance: Add committedInput to the UI TestRunDetail type and document the run-detail field is done
